3.text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

4.text: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,<sup foot_note="228276">1</sup>

footnotes.228276: - The people will be as such after having been expelled from their graves.

5.text: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.<sup foot_note="228277">1</sup>

6.text: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

7.text: He will be in a pleasant life.

8.text: But as for one whose scales are light,

9.text: His refuge<sup foot_note="228278">1</sup> will be an abyss.<sup foot_note="228279">2</sup>

footnotes.228278: Literally, "mother" (a man's original refuge) , which will envelop him as in an embrace.

10.text: And what can make you know what that is?

11.text: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
